The files of this folder are copies of the data that the specs of the corpus
read. They came from the testdata of github.com/xo/vegagoja at commit
eb05b17, which took them from vega-datasets.

vega-datasets is at https://github.com/vega/vega-datasets. The package is
under the BSD 3-Clause License, as its package.json states, and the
repository holds no LICENSE file of its own. Each dataset also has a source
and a license of its own. datapackage.json, from the tag v3.3.1 of
vega-datasets, lists them under "sources" and "licenses" for each file.

Three files that the corpus names are left out, because they are large and
only specs that bind events read them, which the first release does not
support (D7): flights-200k.json, flights-20k.json and
platformer-terrain.json. The inventory marks the specs that need them.
